title: RULES ON THE REPORT AND DISCLOSURE OF MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS OF CANDIDATES FOR PUBLIC ELECTIONS
title_original: 공직선거후보자의 병역사항 신고 및 공개에 관한 규칙
full_text: RULES ON THE REPORT AND DISCLOSURE OF MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS OF CANDIDATES FOR PUBLIC ELECTIONS Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated to National Election Commission Rules by the Act on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Public Servants (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and matters necessary for its enforcement. Article 2 (Reporting of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections) Pursuant to Article 9 (Reporting and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections) (1) of the Act, a person intending to become a candidate for a public election shall submit the military service records prescribed in Article 3 (Persons Subject to Reporting and Military Service Records to Be Reported) of the Act to the election commission of the relevant electoral district (hereinafter referred to as the "district commission"), using the Report on Military Service Records of a Candidate for Public Election in attached Form 1, when applying for registration as a candidate. Article 3 (Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections) Article 20 (Registration of Candidates) (6) of the Rules on Management of Public Elections shall apply mutatis mutandis to the disclosure of military service records of candidates for public elections under Article 9 (Reporting and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections) (3) of the Act. [Wholly amended on 2002.3.21] Article 4 (Verification of Reported Military Service Records) (1) In any of the following cases, the chairperson of the competent district commission may request the Commissioner of the Military Manpower Administration to verify the reported military service records or order the candidate concerned to submit relevant supporting documents: 1. Where a candidate, an election campaign manager, the head of an election liaison office, or a voter in the relevant electoral district raises a written objection, accompanied by supporting documents, on the grounds of an omission or false report in the military service records reported by a particular candidate; 2. Where the chairperson of the competent district commission deems it necessary. (2) A request for verification or an order to submit supporting documents under paragraph (1) shall be made using parts (a) and (b) of attached Form 3. Article 5 (Handling of Verification Results) (1) When the chairperson of the competent district commission has verified the matters raised in an objection under Article 4 (1) 1, the chairperson shall notify the objector of the results; where intentional omission or false reporting is confirmed in the candidate's reported military service records, the chairperson shall publicly announce the verified content using attached Form 4. (2) Where, as a result of verification conducted ex officio under Article 4 (1) 2, the chairperson of the competent district commission confirms intentional omission or false reporting in the candidate's reported military service records, the chairperson shall publicly announce it in accordance with attached Form 4. Article 6 (Notification of Military Service Records of Elected Persons) Notification to the Commissioner of the Military Manpower Administration and the head of the affiliated institution of the military service records of elected persons under Article 9 (4) of the Act and Article 16 (Notification of Military Service Records of Elected Persons, etc.) (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Public Servants shall be made using attached Form 5. ADDENDUM These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. ADDENDUM (Rules on Management of Public Elections) Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. Article 2 (Amendments to Other Rules) (1) Omitted. (2) The Rules on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections are amended as follows. Article 3 shall read as follows: Article 3 (Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections) Article 20 (Registration of Candidates) (5) of the Rules on Management of Public Elections shall apply mutatis mutandis to the disclosure of military service records of candidates for public elections under Article 9 (Reporting and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections) (3) of the Act. Attached Form 2 is deleted. ADDENDUM (Rules on Management of Public Elections) Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. Articles 2 through 5 Omitted. Article 6 (Amendments to Other Rules) (1) Omitted. (2) The Rules on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections are amended as follows. In Article 3 (Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections), "paragraph (5)" is replaced by "paragraph (6)". ADDENDUM (Rules on Management of Public Elections) Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) Omitted. (2) The Rules on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections are partially amended as follows. Attached Form 1 shall be as attached. (3) Omitted. ADDENDUM These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. ADDENDUM (Rules on Management of Public Elections) Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. Article 2 (Amendments to Other Rules) (1) Omitted. (2) The Rules on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Candidates for Public Elections are partially amended as follows. Attached Form 1 shall be as attached. ADDENDUM These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. ADDENDUM These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS OF THE CANDIDATE AND OTHER PERSONS | ① Affiliated political party | | ② Name of election and electoral district | | ③ Name | | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | ④ Relationship to candidate | ⑤ Name | ⑥ Date of birth | ⑦ Military service records | ⑧ Remarks | |---|---|---|---|---| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | INSTRUCTIONS FOR COMPLETING MILITARY SERVICE RECORDS OF THE CANDIDATE AND OTHER PERSONS ① An independent candidate shall enter "Independent" in the "Affiliated political party" field. ② In the "Name of election and electoral district" field, do not enter an electoral district name for presidential elections, elections of heads of local governments, elections of proportional-representation members of the National Assembly, or elections of proportional-representation members of local councils. ③ In the "Name" field, enter the name of the person required to report in Hangul. ④ In the "Relationship to candidate" field, distinguish the candidate, the candidate's spouse (persons prescribed by Presidential Decree, including persons who completed active service during their marriage to the person required to report), and lineal descendants (including maternal grandsons). Enter lineal descendants in birth order as indicated below; these are lineal descendants aged 18 or older at any time during the period from January 1 through December 31 of the year in which the person became required to report. However, exclude women not subject to military service obligations and men under 18 years of age. "Instructions for entries" 1. Distinguish candidate, spouse, son, grandson, and maternal grandson. 2. For sons, enter "eldest son", "second son", "third son", etc. 3. For grandsons and maternal grandsons, enter only "grandson" or "maternal grandson". ⑤ In the "Name" field, enter the name of the person subject to reporting in Hangul. ⑦ In the "Military service records" field, reproduce exactly the military service records appearing on the certificate of military service record issued by the head of the regional military manpower office, but do not enter the "military service number". ⑧ In the "Remarks" field, where the person required to report requests non-disclosure of the name of a disease, details of a physical or mental disability, or reasons for a disposition concerning that person, the person's spouse, or a lineal descendant under Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Report and Disclosure of Military Service Records of Public Servants, enter "Request for Non-Disclosure of Disease Names, etc.".
